rationale: Builds directly on the current best script instead of spending another run on broader recurrence or global MLP EMA. The current winner already proved that columnwise int8 handling of `mlp.fc.weight` matters, while the final block is already rescued in FP16; this change therefore extends the existing late projection EMA only to the remaining late quantized `mlp.fc.weight` tensors in the tail. That specifically targets the penultimate/antepenultimate MLP expansion matrices that still dominate final roundtrip error, keeps artifact size unchanged, preserves the exact final int8+zlib path, and avoids the over-smoothing that hurt the earlier all-MLP-expansion EMA run.
title: Tail MLP-FC EMA On Best Quant Path
